name: wordbridge-plugin
description: WordBridge Plugin bundles Windows desktop Word MCP tools, a companion skill, and connection status UI. Persistent fast mode and cursor insertion.

interface.shortDescription: Connect to desktop Word with guided tools.
interface.longDescription: Read active Word document metadata and selected text; append or insert at a body cursor with confirmation in normal mode or directly after the user explicitly enables session fast mode. Windows desktop Word and a separately prepared Python environment are required. Installation and upgrade were verified on Windows; supported scope is saved local DOCX body text.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use WordBridge Plugin to check the Word connection without modifying the document.
